$comment: Order status automation is NOT here on purpose: it needs to run every 15 minutes, and Vercel's Hobby plan rejects any cron more frequent than daily (it fails the whole deployment). It runs from .github/workflows/order-status-cron.yml instead. On a Pro plan you can move it back here as { "path": "/api/cron/order-status", "schedule": "*/15 * * * *" } and disable that workflow.
